Headlines are written to exercise specific pipeline behaviours (see each item's `note`), including the name collisions from project_context.md section 4.3 and the sentiment edge cases from section 6.2. P3.2 adds `--record` to capture a real GDELT corpus alongside this one; until then the README must not describe these as recorded traffic. Dates are relative (`-3d`) so the corpus never falls out of the rolling 90-day window (A1).
